name: Smart Featured Videos for WooCommerce
author: Muhammad Haris

sections.description:
Smart Featured Videos for WooCommerce allows you to add a featured video to your WooCommerce products. Enhance your product pages by displaying a video in place of or alongside the featured image. Supports YouTube, Vimeo, and self-hosted video URLs. Videos are displayed in the product gallery and can be played in a lightbox or embedded player.

Key Features:

  • Add a featured video to any WooCommerce product
  • Supports YouTube, Vimeo, and self-hosted (MP4, WebM) videos
  • Seamless integration with WooCommerce product gallery
  • Option to play videos in a lightbox or embedded view
  • Easy-to-use interface within the product editor
  • Lightweight, developer-friendly, and easy to extend

Perfect for showcasing product demos, instructions, or marketing content directly on your store pages.

External Services

This plugin optionally embeds videos using the following services:

  1. YouTube

    • Embedded via iframe.
    • May collect user data (Google Terms apply).
    • YouTube Terms
    • Privacy Policy

  2. Vimeo

    • Embedded via iframe.
    • May collect user data.
    • Vimeo Terms
    • Privacy Policy

  3. Self-hosted videos

    • Uploaded and hosted by the site owner.
    • No third-party service is used.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/smart-featured-videos-for-woocommerce/, or install via the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins page.
  3. Edit a product and add a video URL in the new Featured Video box (YouTube, Vimeo, or self-hosted video URL).
  4. Save the product — the video will appear in the gallery on the single product page.
sections.faq:
What video sources are supported?

You can use:
– YouTube
– Vimeo
– Self-hosted videos (MP4, WebM)

Will this replace the featured image?

No, the featured video appears alongside the featured image in the gallery.

Does it work with all themes?

The plugin works with most WooCommerce-compatible themes. Some custom themes may require minor CSS adjustments.

Is autoplay supported?

Yes, for self-hosted and embedded videos. YouTube/Vimeo autoplay works with iframe settings and may depend on browser policies.
